_doc: Regression thresholds for scripts/perf.sh (docs/TESTING.md §3). 'default' = this machine at full speed (release build), 'air' = --air mode (efficiency cores, 8 GB policies). Each metric: max and/or min. Missing metrics are skipped. Tighten when you make something faster; never loosen to hide a regression without saying why in the commit. Timeline '_cpu_' metrics = main-thread CPU time per frame (robust to machine load); '_wall_' = elapsed time (includes preemption by other processes, hence looser). History (M1 Pro): before W14 LOD (wall clock) scroll p95 0.6 ms, zoom 2.0, fit 1.9; air fit 154. After LOD/caches: scroll 0.36, zoom 0.24, fit 0.26; air cpu scroll 1.6-2.1, zoom 3.7-6, fit 0.9-1.7 (wall 7-15 under load 15-30).
